# Vulners Python SDK

> The official Python client for the Vulners vulnerability intelligence API
> (https://vulners.com). Typed synchronous (`Vulners`) and asynchronous
> (`AsyncVulners`) clients for searching CVEs, exploits and advisories, and
> auditing software, hosts, libraries and SBOMs.

Install with `pip install vulners` (Python 3.10+). Authenticate via the
`VULNERS_API_KEY` environment variable or `Vulners(api_key="…")`. The v4 clients
return typed `Bulletin` models and paginate up to a 10,000-document search
window; the legacy v3 `VulnersApi` remains fully supported. A minimal, self-hosted
Model Context Protocol server ships in the `mcp` extra (`pip install
"vulners[mcp]"`, then `vulners-mcp`); the official managed MCP endpoint is hosted
at https://mcp.vulners.com/.

## Docs (source under documentation/)

- [Home & install](documentation/index.md): what the SDK is, install, quickstart.
- [Quickstart tutorial](documentation/tutorials/quickstart.md): first search and audit, sync and async.
- [Migrating v3 → v4](documentation/explanation/migration.md): map v3 calls to their v4 equivalents.

## How-to guides

- [Audit a host](documentation/how-to/audit-a-host.md): Linux/Windows/SBOM/CPE audits.
- [Stream the archive](documentation/how-to/stream-the-archive.md): bulk download and incremental sync.
- [Search exploits](documentation/how-to/search-exploits.md): find exploits/PoCs; expose them to an agent.
- [Proxy, timeouts & retries](documentation/how-to/proxy-timeout-retries.md): network configuration.
